summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-anvil2@9.0.5 ships an obfuscated preinstall dropper. package.json's preinstall runs `node setup.mjs`, itself obfuscated with string-table indirection (variable names like `_0x488df8`, indirection object `_0x19328d.YCZJE` masking routine strings such as `--version`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, `musl`). setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(<bun>, [<pkg>/math_init.js], {stdio:"inherit"})` against the sibling `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript blob using rotated string-array decoding (`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())` loop) and `_0x`-style hex identifiers — the standard obfuscator.io fingerprint — whose behavior is unrelated to the advertised React chat-UI library and is opaque to review. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based install-time inspection: the payload runs under Bun, with the installer's user privileges, on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
